---
title: "Quiz · Design the Metaphor"
---

A short knowledge check. Answers are hidden behind callouts so you can
self-grade after answering.

## 1. What is an "attempt at an isomorphism"?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
A metaphor where every important fact in the model has a counterpart in the story,
and the story does not introduce serious misconceptions that contradict the model.
:::

## 2. What are the four properties of a defensible metaphor?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
Complete enough (covers all participating entities), isomorphic (no serious
contradiction to the model), navigable (listener can map back from story to
model), and playful but honest (entertaining in service of understanding).
:::

## 3. What is "gaming the map"?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
Walking through each key fact from the concept and verifying that the metaphor
respects it. If any key fact fails, the metaphor changes — not the model.
:::

## 4. What is misconception injection?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
When the metaphor introduces an idea that contradicts the real system. For
example, showing the developer talking directly to providers when the model says
they do not.
:::

## 5. Where does the metaphor table live?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
In `metaphor.md`, which serves as the contract between `concept.md` and every
other file in the pipeline.
:::
